recipes.title: Orange Glazed-Turkey with Potatoes and Carrots

ingredients.name: dried mixed herbs (rosemary, basil, parsley, tarragon, chives, thyme, sage)

steps: Coat a 13x9x2-inch baking dish lightly with cooking spray and place the turkey breast in the center.
In a small bowl, stir together the dried herbs, salt, pepper, and garlic powder, then rub half of the mixture evenly across the turkey breast.
Spread the orange marmalade over the top surface of the seasoned turkey breast.
Toss the cut potatoes and carrots with the olive oil and the remaining herb seasoning in a bowl, then arrange them evenly around the turkey in the baking dish.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour until the turkey is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Let the turkey rest for 5 to 10 minutes before carving and serving alongside the roasted vegetables.
recipes.swaps: Dried mixed herbs can be any combination of rosemary, basil, parsley, tarragon, chives, thyme, and sage; any potato variety can be used.
recipes.notes: Equipment: 13x9x2-inch baking dish. Passive time: 5-10 minutes resting after baking.
